Body.Content:
Windows Server 2028, the next Long-Term Servicing Channel (LTSC) release of Windows Server, is now in public preview. It brings together security, virtualization, hybrid cloud management, and hybrid intelligence investments to support mission-critical workloads across datacenters, edge, and cloud environments.

Learn more.
